audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows were wrong in both layers: Level 1 read Skill while whys[0] says Yorick out-trades you, Levels 2-3 read Yorick while whys[1] and whys[2] call them even, Levels 4-5 read Skill while whys[3] says your all-in bursts him down, and Level 6 read Skill while whys[4] hands it to the Maiden.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Yorick / Skill / Skill / Wukong / Yorick / Yorick / Yorick and matches the content prose row for row. No mirror exists yet, so these values set the reference for yorick__wukong.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 4 set to Yorick, rows 1 and 2 to Skill, row 3 to Wukong as matched phases[N].side + win[N] pairs, ratings realigned, and the stage explanations rewritten with the mechanic behind each row.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was the generic Cyclone line on the row where the Maiden arrives, phases[5].why said only 'Black Cleaver is your spike' on a Yorick row, and phases[6].why quoted a carry-threat number.
audit.why: Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100s and summons the Maiden, who both raises Walkers from dead enemies and makes Yorick's attacks on her target hit harder — that is the Level 6 swing. His first item is the grave-clearing and split-push spike, and at two items the summons soak damage he never has to.
audit.corrected: Level 6 stage now names the Maiden and the 160s rank-1 cooldown; the first-item stage names grave clearing and split pressure; the 2+ item stage names the summons soaking damage and the map answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] 'Fight him off Maiden', dontsFull[1] 'Fight into Maiden + ghouls' and dontsFull[2] 'Trade in his ghoul swarm' all carried bodies copied from other rows. Dark Procession being destructible, Mourning Mist's armour shred and mark, and Last Rites' heal-plus-auto-reset were never stated. packet.defects notes the page names none of his abilities.
audit.why: Riot's text: Dark Procession is a destructible wall, so it is broken rather than waited out. Mourning Mist reduces armor, slows and marks, and his summoned units gain move speed toward the marked target — that mark is what pulls the swarm onto you. Last Rites heals him and is flagged an auto reset on 6s at rank 1. The Maiden makes Yorick's attacks on her target deal bonus damage and raises Walkers from dead enemies.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the 20s destructible wall, the 12s Mourning Mist shred-and-mark and the 160s ultimate; dosFull[2].d states the Maiden-target bonus; dontsFull[1].d states the Walker raising; dontsFull[2].d states the mark pulling the swarm. All five ability names now appear.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Dark Procession's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.

edits.before: Black Cleaver is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Dark Procession's cooldown.
